job.title: Principal Contract Recruiter
job.description:
Principal Contract Recruitment Consultant (Technology)

Location: Altrincham (3 days per week)
Salary: £40,000 - £55,000 + strong commission
Benefits: Strong benefits package, flexibility & autonomy

NearTech Search is a specialist technology recruitment business operating at the sharp end of the rapidly growing UK AI Tech market. We place specialist Engineers and  Technology Leaders into high-growth and scale-up businesses across our existing AI Technology Desks (Software, Data, Cloud) – niche, innovative and in-demand high value markets.

This is a genuine opportunity to create, shape and scale a high-performing contracts desk in some of the most sought-after technology markets, with the backing of an experienced recruitment leader and an existing client base that already offers real cross-sell potential for contract solutions.

You'll have the autonomy to build the desk your way, working shoulder-to-shoulder with permanent consultants covering the same clients and technologies. We have a clear market strategy and an approach which works – we have a friendly, ‘no ego’ culture and are looking for someone who wants to work in that type of environment!

The Principal Contract Recruitment Consultant Will…
  • Build and scale your own contract book from day one
  • Stand up a new technology contract recruitment desk within our AI markets
  • Develop contract and interim solutions across NearTech's existing client accounts
  • Win and grow new business, focused on the AI technology markets we already cover
  • Own the full contract recruitment lifecycle end to end
  • Help shape the long-term contracts strategy for the business
  • Grow your desk into your own AI technology recruitment division
What we're looking for
  • Proven technology contract recruitment experience (2+ years)
  • Strong business development and client management skills
  • Genuine ambition to build and grow a contracts function
  • Self-motivated, entrepreneurial and comfortable with a blank canvas
  • Able to work autonomously while collaborating with the wider team
What's on offer
  • £40,000 – £55,000 base salary
  • Strong uncapped commission, paid monthly and quarterly kickers
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in Altrincham)
  • Flexibility and autonomy — your desk and your team to build, with guidance
  • Excellent progression as the division grows
  • A supportive, collaborative, purpose-led (B Corp) environment
  • The chance to build something genuinely exciting inside a fast-growing business
If you want to build a successful contracts desk in some of the most in-demand technology markets globally — with the support, clients and infrastructure already in place - we'd love to hear from you. This is the perfect time to join NearTech and take the next step in your career.

Feel free to contact me directly on LinkedIn – richard@neartechsearch.com

job.title: AI Software Engineer
job.description:
AI Software Engineer
£70k-90k + Equity Options
  
UK Remote | Full-time
A well-funded startup is looking for an AI Software Engineer to build and improve systems that process complex data inputs for enterprise clients, delivering reliable, actionable insights. You'll work with a lean, experienced team who care about getting things right.
  
What You'd Do
  • Own the full technical stack as an AI Software Engineer: data processing, routing logic, model integration, external service connections, and output assembly
  • Take features from concept to production and monitor real-world performance
  • Identify accuracy gaps and solve them across the stack (data quality, prompts, model selection, or replacing ML with logic where it makes sense)
  • Connect third-party services reliably and fail gracefully when they don't work
  • Create test suites and metrics that validate your changes
  • Handle client-specific configurations without creating maintenance nightmares
  • Get direct feedback from end users about how your work gets used
  
What They're Looking For
  
  • 5+ years building software; substantial recent experience with production LLM systems
  • Strong Python skills (3.10+); comfortable building resilient, asynchronous workflows using cloud function frameworks
  • Experience building and deploying agentic systems using LLM abstraction layers, with hands-on work across multiple model providers (Gemini, Claude, etc.)
  • Proficiency with vector embeddings and retrieval optimization for AI pipelines
  • Experience containerising applications (Docker) and managing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)
  • Comfortable working across cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and integrating with services/APIs written in other languages (particularly Node.js)
  • You have opinions about what should be handled by models vs. what belongs in code
  • You've written test data, defined success metrics, and seen them catch real issues
  • You validate your own work critically before others do
  • You investigate what data the model is actually seeing before tweaking prompts
  • You identify gaps and propose solutions without needing a task list
  • Able to lead technical discussions with enterprise customers — explaining complex AI architecture with clarity and confidence
  
Team & Environment
  • Fully remote, small core team
  • Focus on shipping incrementally and learning from real usage
  • Individual ownership of projects from design through deployment
  • Lightweight processes that stay out of your way
  • Regular input from the people who depend on your code
  
Interested? Get in touch and let's discuss what they're building and what the AI Software Engineer role involves.

job.title: MLOps Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
MLOps Infrastructure Engineer

Location: London | Type: Permanent

Salary: £80,000–£100,000 per annum

Role Summary Build and operate reliable infrastructure for a research and product platform handling CAD jobs, model training, simulations, and data pipelines. As an MLOps Infrastructure Engineer, you'll design systems that prevent experiments from becoming cost or reliability surprises, operating LLM serving pipelines, GPU infrastructure, and secure data storage at scale.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build infrastructure for model serving, simulation jobs, and secure data storage.
  • Operate LLM and robotics-model deployment pipelines in production.
  • Implement CI/CD, observability, experiment tracking, and cost controls.
  • Keep CAD, simulation, and model jobs reliable and performant.
  • Design and maintain secure data pipelines supporting repeatable experiments.
  • Support model evaluation workflows and reduce infrastructure cost while maintaining uptime.
  • Monitor frontier API routing, GPU serving, and inference optimization.
Essential Experience
  • Strong proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with GPU serving and inference optimization.
  • Knowledge of job queues, observability platforms, and experiment tracking systems.
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), secrets management, and security practices.
  • Experience implementing cost control and performance monitoring.
  • Familiarity with data storage solutions, model versioning, and deployment workflows.
Advantageous Experience
  • An MLOps Infrastructure Engineer with experience operating LLM serving infrastructure or robotics model pipelines is ideal.
  • Background with CAD job scheduling or simulation workload optimization.
  • Exposure to experiment tracking frameworks and ML model evaluation systems.
  • Experience reducing infrastructure costs in ML/research environments.
  • Knowledge of frontier model APIs and API routing strategies.

Candidate Profile
  • Hands-on MLOps Infrastructure Engineer comfortable supporting research and product teams.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver focused on reliability and cost efficiency.
  • Able to work across multiple job types (models, simulations, data pipelines, CAD).
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proactive about monitoring, debugging, and preventing infrastructure surprises.
What We Offer
  • Hands-on technical role with real infrastructure impact.
  • Opportunity to optimize systems handling diverse workloads (ML, simulation, CAD).
  • Exposure to cutting-edge research and product infrastructure challenges.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Fast-paced environment supporting innovation at scale.
Interested? If you're an experienced MLOps Infrastructure Engineer ready to take on this challenge, we'd love to hear from you.
Get in touch: max@neartechsearch.com

job.title: Technical Lead
job.description:
Technical Lead | SaaS
Hybrid — Central London, 3 days on-site
£110,000–£125,000 ·
Must be eligible for future UK SC clearance
  
We're partnering with a PE-backed, high-growth technology scale-up delivering secure, mission-critical SaaS into UK Defence. It's early enough that you'll help shape how the team and the platform grow, on work that carries real national significance.
  
This is a hands-on Technical Lead role centred on two things: leading software delivery and owning live service operations. You'll lead delivery across an established offshore partner with a view to building up an in house team of Software Engineers in the near future.
  
You will take full ownership of software development and cloud production environment - deployments, patching, automation and the day-to-day operability of the platform. As the product expands into new use cases and markets, you'll support fast, business-driven prototyping to help win and grow work. You'll report into senior leadership, with clear room to grow into an Engineering Director / CTO remit as the company scales.
  
What we're looking for
  • Leading both offshore and in-house engineering teams to deliver enterprise-grade products
  • Hands-on with service operations and DevOps / automation in live service delivery (ownership of a live production environment ideal)
  • Comfortable in security-conscious / regulated environments (Defence or other regulated sectors)
  • Supporting innovation through rapid prototyping in a growing, evolving market to help win and grow business
  • Eligible for UK Security Clearance to at least SC level
  • Building and scaling cloud-based SaaS products — experience of a modern .NET and cloud (AWS) stack is preferred, but not essential for candidates with sound technical judgement and flexibility
  
Nice to have:
  • Experience with government or MoD cloud hosting environments
  • Familiarity with cyber requirement sets such as Secure by Design and DEFSTAN 05-138
  
To apply to this Technical Lead role please submit a copy of your CV ASAP.

job.title: Infrastructure Manager
job.description:
IT Infrastructure & Operations Manager
Near Chester, £70,000
  
A fast-growing UK technology business is hiring an Infrastructure and Operations Manager - a broad, end-to-end role for someone who likes being the person the whole internal tech estate runs through.
  
The role is hands-on and functional-owner in equal measure. The new Infrastructure Manager will own the estate and manage the vendors and consultants around it, while designing the framework that lets the business scale. As the company's international footprint grows, this position is built to become the single point of ownership for global IT infrastructure and ISO 27001 governance - this role has a huge amount of scope for the future.
  
The Infrastructure & Operations Manager will own:
  
  • Infrastructure, cloud & availability — proactive monitoring across servers, storage, firewalls, VPN and email gateway so tooling catches incidents before users do; ongoing management and optimisation of an Azure environment for resilience, cost and performance; backup, DR and business continuity that's documented and genuinely tested.
  • Microsoft 365 & end-user tech — full ownership of the M365 stack (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID), resolving recurring desktop and email-client issues at the root rather than per user, and keeping software licences and SaaS subscriptions under control.
  • Identity, access & credentials — MFA, conditional access and role-based access done properly; company ownership of every vendor, ISP, hosting, domain and certificate account so access is never tied to one individual; a clean, repeatable process for third-party and partner access.
  • Cyber security & compliance — day-to-day ownership of the ISO 27001 ISMS through Stage 2 and the surveillance cycles that follow, driving MFA, Privileged Access Management and certificate-lifecycle work to completion, and maintaining the evidence behind Cyber Essentials Plus and GDPR renewals.
  • Network, assets & documentation — a living map of the estate: network diagrams, system inventory and access model kept current for audit, plus IT asset lifecycle management and consistent cloud configuration standards.
  • Governance & roadmap — IT policies covering acceptable use, data handling and change management; regular reporting to leadership on health, risk and progress; vendor relationships; and a multi-year roadmap for modernisation and security maturity.
  
Experience needed:
  
  • 5+ years running hybrid IT environments across on-premises and cloud
  • Deep Azure (IAM/RBAC, Key Vault, networking, region management), Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online and Windows Server
  • Strong grounding in cyber security best practice and frameworks, with hands-on ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials (Plus) and GDPR
  • Experience administering an email security gateway / MTA, including DMARC, SPF and DKIM
  • Rolled out MFA and Privileged Access Management, ideally in a regulated or insured environment
  • Comfortable with monitoring and alerting tooling and designing incident-response processes
  • Backup, DR and continuity plans you've built and tested
  • Hands-on with network security tooling — firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint protection
  • A clear communicator who can be the primary point of contact and set out risk and timelines to non-technical leadership.
  • Awareness of data-privacy and data-residency requirements for enterprise clients.
  • Background in a SaaS product company or software vendor.
  
This is a great opportunity with a blank canvas: real autonomy, budget to modernise, and a clear path to owning infrastructure and governance across a growing international business.
  
£70,000 · near Chester · 4+ days on-site. Apply with a current CV and we'll be in touch to talk through the detail.
